mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases over three months do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% in 2 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines > 1% QoQ does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
